chunks: As your Lord sent you from your home for the true cause, a section of the faithful were averse,

key_terms.بِالْحَقِ: With the truth / for the true cause

ai.seo_question: Why were some believers averse to the Prophet's departure for battle?
ai.summary: This verse, revealed during the Battle of Badr, confirms the Prophet's departure from Medina as an act of divine truth (al-haqq), validating his leadership despite the internal dissent of a faction of believers who were reluctant to engage in combat. Shia scholarship often highlights this reluctance as a precursor to the later conflict between the Prophet's authority and the emerging opposition, underscing the tension between obedience to divine command and human hesitation.
